The '''Vellity system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="GMK" /> located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vellity]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Borneck]].<ref name="AE" />
